title: Autonomy Register — Section J: RAF Mandatory Fields
description: Section J of the Autonomy Register entry, as specified in STD-EDS-007.

raf_responsible_use_ref.description: [Mandatory for all RAF-scope systems] Format: RUA-YYYY-NNN. Must reference a current entry in REG-RAF-001. Null only where system is not yet RAF-scope assessed. (Source of truth: REG-RAF-001 — populated by CAIO office within 5 business days of assessment completion)

data_provenance_certified.description: Values: true │ false. True only where all training dataset provenance records are complete and CAIO-approved under STD-RAF-003. Reset to false when any data retirement trigger is identified, or where a screen under STD-RAF-003 §7.3 indicates the assessment would not have passed under the corrected requirement, until the required reassessment is completed. (Source of truth: System Owner — updated within 5 business days of any provenance status change)

provenance_assessment_date.description: Date of the most recent completed provenance assessment for the primary training dataset. Must be within the currency period for the system’s domain per STD-RAF-003 §3.3. (Source of truth: System Owner)

provenance_dataset_ids.description: Format: [SystemID]-DATA-NNN per STD-RAF-003 §2.1. Comma-separated list of all training dataset IDs for the current model version. Updated on each model version change. (Source of truth: System Owner)

consent_basis_status.description: [Mandatory where training data includes personal information] Values: Active │ Expiring (within 60 days) │ Expired │ Not Applicable. Updated when consent basis status changes. (Source of truth: System Owner with CISO oversight)

data_quality_assessment_date.description: Date of the most recent data quality assessment across all four dimensions (completeness, accuracy, currency, representativeness) for the primary training dataset per STD-RAF-003 §3. (Source of truth: System Owner)

data_quality_result.description: Values: Pass │ Conditional Pass │ Fail. If Fail: system may not be in production. (Source of truth: System Owner — CAIO notified immediately on Fail)

last_distribution_shift_test_date.description: [Mandatory for Tier 1 and 2 systems] Date of the most recent KS distribution shift test per STD-RAF-003 §3.3. Required quarterly for Tier 1; biannually for Tier 2 and 3. (Source of truth: System Owner)

distribution_shift_result.description: [Mandatory for Tier 1 and 2 systems] Values: No Shift │ Warning (approaching threshold) │ Shift Detected. Shift Detected triggers retirement assessment under STD-RAF-003 §5. (Source of truth: System Owner — CAIO notified within 5 business days of Shift Detected result)

bias_assessment_status.description: [Mandatory for all systems affecting individuals] Values: Current │ Overdue │ Not Required │ Suspended. Current = assessment within the cadence defined in STD-RAF-001 §4.1, with no event-triggered reassessment under POL-RAF-002 §4.2 outstanding beyond its required timeframe. Overdue = a scheduled reassessment date has passed without completion, or an event-triggered reassessment has not been completed within the timeframe specified for that trigger. (Source of truth: System Owner — CAIO monitors

last_fairness_assessment_date.description: [Mandatory where bias_assessment_status ≠ Not Required] Date the most recent STD-RAF-001 fairness assessment was completed. (Source of truth: System Owner)

fairness_assessment_reference.description: [Mandatory where bias_assessment_status ≠ Not Required] Reference to the STD-RAF-001 compliant assessment report. Filed in the AI QA gate record or the system’s governance file. (Source of truth: System Owner)

bias_assessment_outcome.description: [Mandatory where bias_assessment_status ≠ Not Required] Values: Pass │ Conditional Pass │ Fail. If Fail or Conditional Pass: conditions and remediation timeframe recorded in the assessment report. (Source of truth: System Owner — CAIO notified immediately on Fail)
